featured.name: Scenr.io
featured.summary: Better hiring for infrastructure roles: the candidate is dropped into an isolated cloud account with a broken system running, and we watch how they debug it.
featured.why: At Fampay I ran release engineering for 100 engineers across 180 repositories, and saw us hire infrastructure and security engineers on DSA puzzles, which is far from proof of work.
what: Built the product and sold it myself: more than 100 prospect conversations, closing Scaler, Fampay and ArcFront, with hands-on demos to Stripe, ClickHouse, Emergent and others.
Customers used it to hire a Head of Infra, SDE 2s, database administrators and security engineers.
The control plane also ran AI SRE evaluations, and we worked with AI SRE companies on those.
featured.outcome: Fampay became the first customer and made it mandatory for all its infrastructure interviews. Raised angel funding and received acquisition offers.

featured.name: RAS: Release Any System
featured.summary: Release automation for teams on bare metal and VMs, with support for Kubernetes, ECS, Cloudflare and Vercel as targets.
featured.why: Kubernetes already has good GitOps tools. Self-managed servers have no standard release process, and that is where one platform engineer is stretched thinnest.
what: Sets up CI, progressive delivery, health checks, load tests during the release, and rollback.
One Go binary with no database. Every event goes to a hash-chained ledger, and AI agents act only through scoped, expiring grants.
Run against more than 100 open source repositories. The largest systems deployed with it are Gitea, Kubernetes and OpenTelemetry, built from source rather than from Docker images.

featured.name: CausalCircuit: AI SRE
featured.summary: An on-call agent that works out which fault caused which symptom during an incident, and research into why AI SRE agents that know the answer still fail to find it.
what: Connects to the infrastructure tools, collects telemetry and logs, and traces each symptom back to the fault behind it.
Every action runs under tightly scoped permissions.
The research, Knowing But Not Looking, tests whether small, targeted weight edits repair investigation failures without retraining.
Templates and automations from the agent are with Fampay's infra team, who are testing them on real infrastructure.
A paper on consequence-aware evaluation of AI SREs is submitted to the A2NetOps workshop at AAAI.
